prompt: Convert $64$ ounces to pounds. ($16$ oz $= 1$ lb)
hint: Ounces are smaller than pounds, so the number of pounds will be smaller than $64$. Which operation makes groups out of the ounces?

hints.text: Ounces are smaller than pounds, so the number of pounds will be smaller than $64$. Which operation makes groups out of the ounces?
Every $16$ ounces makes one pound, so count how many groups of $16$ fit in $64$: find $64 \div 16$.
$64 \div 16 = 4$, so a weight of $64$ ounces is $4$ pounds.

explanation: Going from a smaller unit to a larger unit gives fewer units, so divide.
Each pound is a group of $16$ ounces, so compute $64 \div 16$.
Use a multiplication fact to divide: because $16 \times 4 = 64$, the quotient is $4$.
Sixty-four ounces are the same weight as $4$ pounds.
